text:
I have just deployed to production the fixes for false “Mint Successful” modals and the broken approval-to-mint flow.

The changes are:

\- Modal gating: A success modal now appears only when the mint receipt matches the current mint hash and has not previously been shown. Adding or removing referral codes will not activate it.
\- New-attempt reset: Clicking mint clears the previous success state, pending parameters, and tracking references, preventing stale results from carrying into another attempt.
\- USDC auto-mint: Once approval completes, the USDC mint runs immediately because the stale success guard has been removed; approval by itself can no longer produce success.
\- ETH pricing and buffer: Dynamic ETH pricing still chooses the higher of the live value and the contract minimum of 0.014 ETH, then applies the buffer. This is unchanged from the previous hotfix.

After a hard refresh with Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R, please test again:
\- For USDC, approval should automatically initiate the mint, and the modal should wait until the mint transaction confirms.
\- For ETH, a failed transaction should produce no success modal; only an actual mint receipt can trigger one.
